name: web_search
description: Search the live web when current or source-backed information is needed. Use the user's language and send a concise search-engine query. Only use facts directly supported by returned extracts; search again when evidence is insufficient.

query.description: A concise web search query, maximum 500 characters.

name: github_list_repositories
description: List repositories available through the user's connected ReMind GitHub App installations. Call this before assuming repository access.

name: github_get_repository_map
description: Read the file tree and metadata of a connected GitHub repository. This tool is read-only.

branch.description: Optional branch; defaults to the repository default branch.

name: github_read_file
description: Read one UTF-8 text file from a connected GitHub repository. Secret-like, credential, key, certificate, and environment files are blocked.

ref.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit; defaults to the default branch.

name: python_execute
description: Execute Python in the isolated ReMind runner. Read the python skill for execution, verification and artifact rules. Available input filenames: {{availableInputFiles}}.

code.description: Complete Python script, maximum 24000 characters. The runtime is fresh on every call and has no network access.

purpose.description: A concise user-language progress summary, maximum 1000 characters: what this execution will verify or produce and, for later calls, which prior result led to it. State conclusions, not hidden chain-of-thought.

name: image_crop
description: Crop one available image by exact pixel coordinates. The crop is immediately attached back to your next model turn so you can inspect fine details and decide whether another crop is needed. Use deliver_to_user=false for internal visual analysis and true only when the crop itself is a requested final deliverable. Coordinates are based on the original image dimensions returned by this tool.

purpose.description: Concise user-language progress summary explaining which region is being inspected and why. Do not reveal hidden chain-of-thought.

name: image_tile
description: Split a large available image into a 1x1 through 3x3 inspection grid. Every tile is attached back to your next model turn with its exact source coordinates. Use this when the full image is too dense or large to inspect reliably, then follow up with image_crop on important areas. Tiles are internal analysis material and are not delivered to the user.

purpose.description: Concise user-language progress summary explaining why the image is being split. Do not reveal hidden chain-of-thought.

name: read_skill
description: Load the server-owned instructions for one available capability before using it. The instructions become system context on the next tool round.

name: render_visualization
description: Publish an interactive HTML fragment inside the chat. Read the visualize skill first. A local path is not a renderable output.

filename.description: Exact name of an already available input or tool artifact; not a filesystem path or URL.

name: canvas_write
description: Create or replace the current Canvas document with complete content. Read the canvas skill first.

type.description: document or code/language, such as code/html.

filename.description: Exact name of an already available text file instead of content.

name: render_widget
description: Publish a validated chart, diagram, rhythm sequencer or quiz using the corresponding loaded skill.

content.description: JSON object serialized as text for charts, BeatBox or quiz; diagram source text for Mermaid or nomnoml.

name: generate_demo_image
description: Generate an internal diagnostic test image, not production artwork. Read the demo_image skill first.
